differences.what: Black frame side panel: A carries a dark vertical reflection streak that gives the side a modelled, glossy read and separates it from the front; B's side goes flat and shows internal board clutter, then breaks into an abrupt horizontal grey band in its lower third that reads as a render artefact

Red frame side panel: A's side is a darker, even translucent red that keeps the front face dominant; B's side is lighter with the internal side board and a washed-out white patch at the lower right, busier and less glass-like
Water-clear frame side panel: B's side is brighter and evenly lit so the interior structure reads cleanly; A's side has a darker gradient that adds depth but slightly muddies the clear acrylic
Hard horizontal light cutoff on the lower side panel appears in all three frames of B (and more softly in A), a visible seam in the reflection rather than a smooth falloff
